Thesis: Howard Hughes Holdings, Breakout-flagged with clean structure, 91% of its 20-day range, up/down volume 1.27. The catalyst is live: Bill Ackman publicly backed the plan to turn it into a diversified holding company built around the Vantage insurance business bought in June, and executives bought shares after his post. The dated event is INSIDE the window: the annual meeting on Wed Sept 30, where Ackman and management present strategy and take questions. That is the thing ahead of it, and because it falls inside the window the rule takes one point off conviction. Without it this would be a 4. It is 24.9% below its 52-week high. Events by hand: earnings early November, no dividend, no pending M&A. The Vantage deal closed in June, not this week.

Molecular diagnostics at 97% of its 20-day range, 0.8% off an all-time high, up/down volume 4.85, +2 streak. Events by hand: earnings Nov 5, no dividend. ROTH's healthcare conference on Sept 29 is invitation-only and no Natera slot could be confirmed. No FDA date, no pending M&A.

87% of its 20-day range, 3.6% off a 52-week high, up/down volume 2.05, up about 30% in a month. Crossed $1 trillion on Sept 21 and holds 96% of its 20-day range, 1.3% off a 52-week high, on up/down volume 13.19. Data-centre revenue grew 107% last quarter, and management has guided to data-centre sales doubling in 2027. EXTENDED +19.4% and VOLEXP: expect a wider move than the 9.3% estimate. Held to 3: the hole is that AI hardware is the most crowded theme in this tape and Micron reports Wed Sept 30 after the close. Power modules for AI processors. On Sept 21 Vicor doubled its Q3 guide, from nearly 10% to more than 20% sequential growth, on royalties from a Vertical Power Delivery licence granted to a leading AI OEM on Sept 16. The stock closed up 19.9% at $268.34 on Sept 22. It closed Friday at $281.96, above that gap-day close, on up/down volume of 4.38. The gap is holding on confirming volume, and under the rubric that drift is what lies ahead. The guidance raise comes from a recurring royalty stream on a licence, not a one-time item, which answers the flatterer question. The risk named in coverage is that the licence is non-exclusive, so the customer can source modules elsewhere. EXTENDED +35.0%, so expect it to travel well past the 14.6% estimate. This takes the single conviction-4 slot for the crowded AI-hardware theme. Events by hand: Q3 earnings Oct 20, no dividend, no investor day, no pending M&A inside the window.
